validation_boundary: The authoritative ATOM Pydantic model, atom-kind sufficiency validator, JSON Schema, and SEA v4 protocol were not directly retrievable. Structural validation therefore uses a strict local Pydantic contract and generated JSON Schema reconstructed from recent validated project LiteratureAtom guideline outputs plus the large-source guideline guardrail. This report does not claim execution of unavailable authoritative project code.

duplicate_review.finding: Seventeen intentional cross-section recommendation repeats were mapped to the first occurrence and not serialized twice. No exact duplicate canonical statements remain in the merged atom set.

consistency_review.finding: Recommendation strength and evidence certainty are preserved in canonical text and tags. Evidence-profile study results remain secondary reports. Appendix B process limitations are preserved rather than silently corrected.

schema_gaps: The recent project LiteratureAtom pattern has no dedicated guideline_recommendation or not_graded_guidance atom kind. Formal guidance is represented as atom_kind="other" with recommendation, strength, certainty, and ungraded tags.
Recommendation strength and GRADE certainty do not have dedicated typed fields in the reconstructed project pattern, so they remain in canonical text and tags.
Evidence profiles summarize underlying studies. Primary-study atoms require separate extraction of the cited original publications.
extraction_limitations: Canonical statements were normalized from the PDF text layer to repair line-wrap hyphenation, ligature spacing, and formatting artifacts.
The 152-page evidence-profile file was used for SEA evidence reconciliation rather than atomizing each registry row or underlying study result.
All atoms remain needs_review because extraction and normalization were performed by a language model without human verification.
No external literature update or current-guideline comparison was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
